key_decisions: MPI-536 closed on Fabio's own live run, not on an agent check - the add-flow playbook puts the real generation with the user.
The foley dep sits on ltx-23-balanced ONLY. A Flow's weight goes on the tier that can actually run it, not on the model family - the graph bakes the int8 transformer.

ltx23-lora-foley ships with NO mirrorUrl. The only upstream copy is a GATED repo (401, X-Error-Code: GatedRepo), so a mirror would fail every failover it exists for. MPI-538 must check DubIt's gate before assuming it can mirror.
v1 foley is foley-only. Reference/voice audio was NOT dropped - it is unexposed because it has never been executed, and the two modes are mutually exclusive in one file.

The foley Flow REPLACES the source clip's audio - Output_Video takes audio from the model's decode and nothing consumes Input_Video's own audio track. There is no mix control and adding one needs a bench re-export.

Last session shipped MPI-536 (LTX 2.3 foley) end to end and CLOSED it - the LoRA is staged to R2, the Flow ships with declared controls and no uiComponent, and Fabio ran a live generation in his own app and approved the result. That live run also proved MPI-531 item 1 for real. Separately, the latent-preview consumers diverge from the contract docs/preview-bus.md already defines - the minimised mini-window shows one still frame while the Flow result pane replays the clip fast on every sampler step - which needs its own card, not a patch. Reference audio for LTX needs a BENCH session, not app work. The active card is MPI-531 (doing). MPI-557 belongs to a different session and must not be touched.
